label: TP
reason: Both alerts indicate vulnerabilities. Alert 2 (java/xml/xpath-injection) is a confirmed TP: user-supplied input from request headers flows directly into the XPath expression at line 72 without sanitization. Alert 1 (java/xss) follows the instruction to prefer TP when attacker-controlled data reaches the sink, despite the presence of encodeForHTML at lines 86-88. The root cause for both is the unvalidated header parameter becoming bar and reaching sensitive sinks.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request headers into param variable.
Unsanitized bar variable concatenated into XPath expression (Alert 2 TP).
bar variable passed to response.getWriter() via encodeForHTML (Alert 1 TP per balanced encoding guideline).
